status_semantics.implemented-active: implementation is present and connected in the reviewed candidate source; this is not runtime acceptance, accuracy, or readiness evidence
status_semantics.partial: implementation is present with a known contract, dependency, or coverage gap
status_semantics.disconnected: code exists but has no live caller / cannot be reached from the committed tree
status_semantics.proposed: declared or decided only; not implemented
status_semantics.unverified: the stated runtime or product behavior has not been established by suitable evidence
status_semantics.findings: for kind=finding, status preserves the state of the affected surface at the pinned baseline; candidate fixes are described in feature entries and canonical docs
status_semantics.slices: for kind=slice, status summarizes source integration only; it does not imply that every linked feature, dependency, or acceptance gate passed

known_limitations: Source fingerprints are pinned after semantic review of the affected contracts, lifecycle, score provenance, access control and reporting behavior. Matching hashes indicate source consistency only; the strict drift gate remains enabled.

Semantic reassessment on 2026-09-29 compared the changed entries listed in the integration review with candidate source and focused test references. Baseline finding statuses remain historical. No implemented-active status establishes runtime acceptance, model accuracy, live-camera readiness, or a passed gate.

The candidate makes optional imports explicit (SC-10), adds admin protection for POST /api/analyze and a credential-session route (F-45/R-8), wires basic detection queue telemetry (F-36/S-08), and adds evidence-ledger statistics (F-61/S-13). Each retains the specific coverage and live-operation limits recorded on its entry.

Incident face detection/capture (S-15/F-56/F-57) is distinct from identity recognition (F-30), which remains disconnected. Legacy FaceIntelEngine persistence tests exercise an internal library and do not establish a product identity route.

The startup calibration gate now binds calibration to the model checkpoint and rejects missing or changed checkpoints and conflicting calibration environment values. Focused policy tests cover this guard; calibration quality, ECE, and a usable production artifact remain unverified.

limitations: Alert `severity` and the frontend validator are two independent enumerations with no test or config validation linking them: the backend can emit `severity: "none"` (`DecisionConfig.severity_for` → `"none"` below `severity_medium_threshold` = 0.40) while `parseAlertEnvelope` accepts only `{critical, high, medium}` and silently returns `null`. entries.title: Reporting (offline + PDF + remote text)
limitations: Offline reporting and PDF publication are present. The remote OpenRouter module is absent and explicitly DISABLED (F-26); unit tests do not verify external credentials/service behavior. The offline report must retain facts-only claim discipline.

entries.title: Incident face detection and capture
limitations: The optional YuNet detector supports incident face capture and uncertain association only; identity recognition (F-30) remains intentionally disconnected. Asset availability and detection accuracy are not established by unit tests.

entries.title: Audio
limitations: Primary risk to manage: no UI caller; audio.enabled: false

entries.title: Categories / multi-detection
limitations: Primary risk to manage: must stop mutating the shared weapon_engine (R-5); fix the "X3D" label claim (F-29)

entries.title: Notifications (Telegram)
limitations: Primary risk to manage: untested; queue-full drops invisible

entries.title: Security / auth / audit
limitations: Primary risk to manage: every mutating route must authorize before mutation; ADMIN_API_KEY empty ⇒ 503 for all mutations (demo-mode semantics)

entries.title: Bench / measurement harness
limitations: Only this slice writes bench/results and reports pin a revision plus file hashes. The valid paired file replay is pinned to 1218a6cb with 16/36 backend hashes matching this candidate; results do not establish exact-source acceptance, accuracy, camera readiness, or deployment performance.

entries.title: Training / dataset tooling
limitations: Primary risk to manage: provenance for shipped weights is UNKNOWN (F-48)

entries.title: Docs contract / repo hygiene
limitations: Semantic reassessment, generated snapshots and strict docs checks pass. Source consistency does not establish runtime acceptance.

entries.title: Overview
limitations: Active-cameras stat and camera health are hardcoded honest "unavailable" (design-map G-3).

Overview now fetches evidence-ledger statistics and labels a session-buffer fallback (F-61/S-13). Persisted evidence records do not represent all alerts and have no historical incident drill-through; active-camera count remains unavailable.

entries.title: Live Monitor
limitations: WebRTC path disabled/unavailable at baseline (F-37 disconnected); MJPEG fallback retained.
No live camera exists in the campaign environment; live badges unverified.

entries.title: Demo Clips
limitations: Replay evidence only; header copy states results are not live observation.
Clip files are LFS-tracked AVIs (F-20).

entries.title: Incidents & Evidence
limitations: Incident evidence fetches use credentials. Viewer controls cannot mutate triage or generate PDF reports; cached verified reports remain readable. Production live-evidence playback remains an acceptance task.

entries.title: Intelligence
limitations: Remote OpenRouter generation is explicitly DISABLED when its optional module is absent (F-26); local deterministic reporting remains available.
No dedicated reports screen exists (design-map G-2).

entries.title: Operations
limitations: GeoDashboard is illustrative client-side geometry (design-map G-7); no server-side geolocation.
Telegram path untested (F-32 partial).

entries.title: System
limitations: Camera-health card hardcoded honest "unavailable"; no camera-presence endpoint consumed.
The `/security/session` route now returns a tested viewer/admin role (F-45); camera presence remains unavailable and final post-upgrade browser validation is pending.

entries.title: App shell & global chrome
limitations: Single-page shell: no per-screen URLs/deep-linking (design-map G-1).

entries.title: Design system: tokens, typography, RTL, a11y, responsive
limitations: Token snapshot is not an accessibility certification (docs/DESIGN.md rule).
WCAG AA for 10px tertiary text unverified in browser (design-map G-5).

entries.title: Shared UI data contracts
limitations: Severity `none` is accepted and normalized to a display tier; envelope and selector tests cover it. UI contract tests do not replace backend authorization or live SSE integration tests.

entries.title: Incident capture (post-alert, bounded drop-oldest queue)
limitations: Single trigger site: RenderThread._emit_alert (verified in the assembled api.py/pipeline_render.py)
tracking-eval run CONTENDED under the corrected RESOURCE-LOCK protocol; clean re-run owed

entries.title: Best-frame selection records
limitations: SC-8 best_frames layout under EVIDENCE_DIR

entries.title: Enhancement scheduler + GPU budget (post-alert, bounded)
limitations: api.py seam is integrator-authored (WT-23 handoff defers it; no branch shipped it)
trigger = evidence finalization, one whole-frame crop (subject-level face/person crops remain a follow-up)

entries.title: SC-8 derivative records + labeling
limitations: append_derivative reuses the shared S-07 chain primitive (no duplicated chain)

entries.title: Distortion/utility harness (PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS/identity/utility)
limitations: LPIPS trunk provenance recorded per measurement; thresholds provisional (single fixture)

entries.title: Conditional tier-1 Real-ESRGAN behind the harness
limitations: gated/refused where harness bounds fail; weights untracked (declared external asset)
6 skips in the scoped suite are the gated tier-1 paths

entries.title: Face detection (YuNet) for incidents
limitations: no identity recognition (F-30 face_intel stays unwired by campaign policy)
YuNet asset is a declared external asset

entries.title: Face association + crop capture (uncertain association, explicit status)
limitations: off-alert-path capture; build failures surface as DISABLED (never 500 on health)

entries.title: Incident triage state machine + /alerts/{id}/triage API
limitations: process-scoped state; visible rejected envelopes; severity single source

entries.title: Startup calibration gate (G-06)
limitations: The guard binds the artifact to the model checkpoint SHA-256 and rejects missing/changed checkpoints or conflicting transform/class environment values; per-instance transforms use the same explicit model profile. Focused policy tests pass, but calibration quality, ECE, and a usable production artifact remain unverified; the exact development override is documented in RUNBOOK.

entries.title: Decision false-positive screen (negatives-only sweep)
limitations: measured on KTH aux negatives only; the six-class suite is declared uncovered

entries.title: Statistics overview route (GET /stats/overview)
limitations: Counts are evidence-ledger records filtered by evidence-write timestamp (UTC) and exact camera scope, not alerts that occurred in the window. Alert type and latency are unavailable; unit tests establish these semantics, not live completeness or model accuracy.

entries.title: Frame/crop reference schema (sentinel.crop_ref/v1)
limitations: Schema consumed by WT-23 enhancement and WT-21 incident face capture; small-face recall and camera-domain accuracy remain unverified.

entries.title: Monotonic clock quantization (15.625 ms) labelled, not hidden
limitations: hardware/OS clock characteristic measured on this host; cross-boundary ages are computed on the declared captureClockBase only
